data: Amazon reported diluted earnings per share of $2.90 for fiscal 2023, compared with a diluted loss per share of $(0.27) for fiscal 2022, according to its fiscal 2023 Form 10-K. Because 2022 was a loss, a conventional percentage change is not meaningful. The swing was an improvement of $3.17 per share. Measured mechanically against the absolute value of the 2022 figure, that is roughly a 1,174% increase, but it should be read as a turnaround from loss to profit rather than as a growth rate. Net income for fiscal 2023 was $30,425 million (about $30.4 billion), compared with a net loss of $2,722 million in fiscal 2022.
